description: Apalachicola-Chattahoochee-Flint (ACF) River Basin Drought & Water Dashboard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Integrated Drought Information System. Explore timely and reliable information on past, present, and future drought conditions across the Apalachicola-Chattahoochee-Flint (ACF) River Basin. Access interactive maps of streamflow, reservoir, and soil moisture conditions; drought impacts, outlooks and forecasts, and historical drought information. The site offers:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
